dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: I have indeed received Dominus Cassiodor's message. No matter what others may do, I will not stray from my path.

dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: But even if we continue like this, even if our legions conquer all before them, just what will the future of this nation be like...?

dialogues.speaker: Este
dialogues.text: We have no choice but to rely upon the wisdom of the Sebastos...
